# discord_channels (Data Source)

Lists all channels in a Discord guild.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_channels" "all" {
  guild_id = "123456789012345678"
}

output "text_channels" {
  value = [for c in data.discord_channels.all.channels : c.name if c.type == 0]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `guild_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the guild.

### Read-Only

- `channels` (Attributes List) The guild's channels. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--channels))

<a id="nestedatt--channels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `channels`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Channel snowflake ID.
- `name` (String) Channel name.
- `nsfw` (Boolean) Whether the channel is NSFW.
- `parent_id` (String) Parent category channel ID.
- `position` (Number) Channel position.
- `topic` (String) Channel topic.
- `type` (Number) Discord channel type.
